configuration: Diagnosys desktop Espion E3 D315 console with D125-2N ColorDome desktop housing, modeled disconnected and inactive
scope: Static opaque documentary exteriors and detached immutable authored geometry cards

inputs.frame: Integer grid addresses, X right and Y down
inputs.selection: Four stored cards only; no upload or flashing

operation: Remove bounding-box translation of each nonempty pattern; compare its occupied addresses with fixed CARD-A, without rotation or reflection.

outputs.fields: Archive ID, revision, reference/card IDs, grid, occupied cells, area in square millimeters, intersection, union and dimensionless Jaccard overlap when defined

limitations: No equipment settings, stimulation, light timing, waveforms, electrophysiology, procedures, measurements or subjects.
No XR session or headset verification.
